jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to help shape how a large IT company measures, manages and documents its information security? Are you motivated by turning data, risk and regulation into practical decisions? If so, you may be our next colleague in the newly established GRC team in Netcompany's Group CISO Office.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a member of the GRC team, you will help ensure that Netcompany has an accurate, data-driven view of the effectiveness of its security controls and its level of compliance. The team takes a pragmatic and technically grounded approach to governance, risk and compliance, and works closely with the Application Security team, the Operations organisation, Internal IT and other business functions across the group.

The GRC team is a small team of colleagues with complementary profiles. We do not expect any one candidate to cover every area described below. Instead, we are looking for broad profiles with solid experience across several of these areas and the motivation to develop within the rest.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Developing and maintaining risk scenarios, assessing the effectiveness of mitigating controls against the scenarios, and conducting risk assessments to support business decisions

• Establishing automated measurements and KPIs that provide insight into the implementation and effectiveness of security controls across the business

• Interpreting regulatory and contractual security requirements and translating these into Netcompany's security baselines and standard methodologies

• Planning and executing security awareness activities, including phishing simulations, targeted micro-learning, and onboarding/yearly awareness training

• Driving smaller security improvement projects from planning to implementation, combining coordination with hands-on execution

• Developing, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuityDeveloping, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuity

About you

You have broad experience within information security and a solid understanding of its technical aspects alongside a general understanding of the software development life cycle. You combine this with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions. Furthermore, you are pragmatic, take ownership of your work and prefer a hands-on approach.

To succeed in this role you:

• Hold a relevant degree or equivalent experience; within IT, engineering, computer science or a similar field.

• Strong analytic skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions independently.

• Experience within several of the areas listed in the overview of responsibilities in the role.

• Solid communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business functions, management and, on occasion, customers.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

As a Specialist, Digital Engagement, you will play a key role in bringing Pandora’s global campaigns to life across digital touchpoints. You will plan, develop, and execute content across web and email, ensuring engaging and high-performing consumer journeys that align with both brand storytelling and commercial priorities.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will support campaigns end-to-end - from briefing through to execution - ensuring consistency, quality, and continuous optimisation across channels and markets. You will also contribute to refining customer journeys by leveraging insights, performance data, and user behaviour.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute digital campaigns across web and email in line with global brand and commercial strategies

• Translate campaign concepts into engaging, high-performing digital experiences

• Coordinate content across channels and ensure consistency across markets

• Support end-to-end campaign delivery, from briefing to implementation

• Analyse performance data and apply insights to optimise campaigns and customer journeys

• Contribute to continuous improvement of content, placements, and user experience

• Provide guidance and support on local campaign execution

**Your impact

**You will directly influence the quality and effectiveness of Pandora’s digital campaigns and customer journeys across owned channels. Through strong execution and continuous optimisation, you will drive improved engagement, conversion, and brand consistency, while strengthening e-commerce and email performance and enhancing the overall digital customer experience.

**What You’ll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you bring a solid foundation of experience, strong practical skills, and a proactive, hands-on mindset:

**Experience

**

• Approx. 3+ years of experience in digital campaigns, e-commerce, email, or content management

• Experience working within digital marketing, ideally across web and email environments

• Track record of executing digital campaigns and projects

**Skills

**

• Hands-on experience delivering digital-first campaigns in an e-commerce and email

• setup

• Strong understanding of customer journeys and cross-channel execution

• Experience creating engaging digital shopping experiences

• Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into optimisation actions

• Ability to analyse performance data and improve marketing and business KPIs

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Experience from a global organisation is a plus

**Tools

**

• Proficiency in tools such as Excel, Jira, Figma, and PowerPoint

**Key stakeholders

**You will collaborate closely with a broad range of teams across the business to bring campaigns to life end-to-end. This includes colleagues working with brand and creative development, media and marketing activation, retail, and customer engagement (including email and loyalty).

You will also partner with digital and technology teams focused on product, user experience, and engineering, as well as commercial and e-commerce teams across global and regional markets.

In addition, you will work with external partners such as creative and digital agencies, as well as technology and platform providers.

**Ways of working

**You will operate in a fast-paced, agile environment, balancing execution and optimisation while managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders. The role offers a high degree of ownership, with clear objectives and guidance within established frameworks.

**Additional Information

**Global Career Band: 5B

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**Do you want to help ensure quality in energy infrastructure projects? Can you turn quality requirements into practical activities and support projects through to handover? And do you have experience with quality management, audits and inspections? Then join COWI as our new Quality Consultant.

****Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Quality Consultant to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects on assignments of both shorter and longer duration. You will help ensure that projects follow the customer’s governance framework and can be handed over to the operations organisation at the required quality level, with all supporting documentation. Your work may span electricity transmission projects, including cables, overhead lines and substations; gas distribution and transmission networks, including natural gas and biogas facilities and stations; oil pipelines; and gas storage facilities.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support projects in applying internal processes and tools and provide guidance and support on quality-related matters.

• Consistently promote and embed quality management in projects so that documentation, products and deliverables meet the specified requirements

• Plan, carry out and document the necessary quality activities in collaboration with the project team, including internal and external audits and inspections of project partners.

• Ensure that quality-related experience and lessons learned are shared within the customer’s organisation.

• Prepare project quality plans.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You work in a structured and systematic way and take a proactive approach to building relationships. You collaborate and communicate on an equal footing with internal and external stakeholders involved in construction projects. You bring professional credibility in your field and can work independently.

On top of that, you will have:

• An understanding of the structure and application of quality management systems.

• Experience with project- and process-related work.

• Experience with quality management activities in infrastructure and construction projects, including quality assurance (QA) and providing input to quality control (QC) activities.

• Experience carrying out quality activities, including audits and inspections of internal and external parties involved in projects.

• Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.

• The ability to communicate in Danish and English, both orally and in writing, at negotiation level.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Your position

In your new position as a Telecom & Network Engineer in the Telecom Engineering Department, you will join a multicultural, diverse team of skilled, enthusiastic telecommunication specialists from all over the world. As a telecom engineer with a strong network background, you will create, design and develop integrated critical communication systems for the offshore energy industry. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, or in Gdynia or Norfolk. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel from 10-30 days per year depending on which office you will be working at.

“This is an exciting chance to become part of an expanding energy industry, where you can benefit from outstanding career development opportunities. You’ll collaborate with highly skilled and dedicated professionals who are committed to excelling in their field. The role involves working on diverse projects of various scales worldwide, within a collaborative team environment where success is shared” says Head of Engineering, Technology Solutions, Kurt Thorøe.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As a Telecom & Network Engineer, you will design integrated telecom solutions with a strong focus on industrial network technologies. You will take technical responsibility for assigned systems throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements and design through configuration, integration, testing and final documentation Each project is tailored to meet the unique requirements of our clients, providing you with the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge, customized solutions.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Designing and engineering different telecommunication solutions for our clients, which could include network design, CCTV, Line-of-Sight radios and other integrated telecom systems, with a strong focus on network technologies.

• Designing network architecture in accordance with applicable OT security requirements and principles.

• Prepare detail design specification for network to be used for actual implementation.

• Ensuring integration and interface coordination between telecom systems

• Verify configurations and equipment in preparation for Factory Acceptance Tests.

• Performing system configuration, integration and testing as required by the project.

• Following up on subcontractors’ designs, securing technical requirements and interface management.

• Supporting and interacting with subcontractors, customers and other teams across the organisation, such as Telecom Service and the Tender team.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a detail-oriented and structured engineer with a curious and analytical mindset. In addition, you have a proactive and organised approach to your work and thrive in a workday with lots of variation and teamwork.

We imagine that you hold:

• Minimum 5 years of experience within telecom engineering, preferably with strong experience in designing and configuring industrial network systems and a solid understanding of both physical and logical network technologies.

• Knowledge of OT security standards and practices, such as the Purdue Model, IEC 62443, or similar frameworks.

• A relevant degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience from the maritime or offshore energy industry; broader telecommunications experience is considered an advantage.

• Strong technical ownership and project mindset, with the ability to drive assigned systems forward and foster positive collaboration within project teams.

• Strong analytical and technical writing skills, combined with professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

Care to join the movement?

jobs.description:
The Mission: Build the Next Generation of SBC Systems

Ibsen Photonics develops Spectral Beam Combining (SBC) modules for high-power laser architectures, based on our in-house transmission gratings. We are looking for a Laser Engineer to join the High-Power Beam Combining team and contribute across design, assembly, and experimental optimisation of these modules, working closely with colleagues and international partners.

What you will do

• Design and assemble compact SBC modules based on Ibsen's transmission gratings, accounting for optical beam paths, thermal effects, and mechanical constraints

• Optimise optical alignment, mechanical stability, and thermal management at high power loads in iterative design–experiment–optimise cycles

• Characterise beam quality during power scaling, including M², wavefront sensing, and spectral analysis

• Support sourcing of optical and mechanical components and the transition from experimental prototypes to scalable, volume-ready designs

• Collaborate with internal teams and international partners, including occasional overseas visits for joint prototyping and testing

What you bring

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a "build-test-learn" environment.

Ideally, you possess

• MSc or PhD in optics, photonics, laser physics, or a related field

• Documented laboratory experience with high-power optics and/or lasers

• Knowledge of high-power-capable optical design practices, including thermal lensing, runaway effects, and their mitigation, as well as Gaussian optics and beam propagation

• Knowledge of opto-mechanical design practices for high-power devices

• Hands-on experience with precise free-space and/or fibre optical alignment and experimental troubleshooting

• Experience with beam quality measurement and analysis

• Professional proficiency in English

Nice to have

• Experience with SBC or CBC techniques

• Mechanical design of tight-tolerance devices and familiarity with mechanical CAD

• Experience transitioning prototypes toward volume production

• Proficiency in optical simulation tools (e.g. Zemax)

Security and export control: This position is subject to defence-related export control and security requirements. You must be able to obtain the required Danish security clearance.

Why join Ibsen Photonics?

• Visible Impact: Your will work directly on the core technology and design behind next generation of SBC modules, with real autonomy over how you solve the tasks you are given. Your results will carry through from lab prototypes to finished products supplied to international customers

• Working culture: A supportive, flat organisation with short decision paths, open knowledge sharing, and a healthy work-life balance.

Ready to make a difference?

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

• Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

• Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

• Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

• Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

**Must-have Requirements

**

• 8+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

• A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

• Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

• Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

• Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

jobs.occupation: Sales & Business Development Director – Defence & Maritime Security
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

Saildrone’s manufacturing and R&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, an established European entity supporting regional business development, sales, and operations, and a deployment hub in the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast-moving, mission-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation.

THE POSITION

The Sales & Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying, developing, shaping, and capturing business opportunities across defence, maritime security, intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, maritime domain awareness, and hydrographic sectors.

The successful candidate will establish and maintain relationships with defence and government stakeholders, military end users, procurement organizations, defence industry partners, maritime agencies, and commercial customers while driving the adoption of Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and services.

While the primary responsibility will be Germany, the role will also support selected strategic opportunities across Eastern Europe.

As Saildrone expands its Fleet of autonomous vessels, commercial activities, customer engagements, and operational footprint the successful candidate will be expected to assume a leadership role in building and growing the demand and European infrastructure for Saildrone’s next generation platform helping establish the foundation for long-term growth in one of Saildrone's most important international markets.

The ideal candidate will combine strong defence sales experience, deep knowledge of the German and European defence ecosystem, an understanding of government and political processes, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior military, government, and industry leaders.

THE TEAM

The European Sales & Business Development team at Saildrone Europe is responsible for driving the company's growth and market expansion across Europe and selected international markets. The team works closely with government agencies, defence organizations, maritime security stakeholders, research institutions, and commercial customers to identify opportunities, develop strategic partnerships, and deliver innovative maritime domain awareness, Bathymetry, and Meteorology and Oceanography solutions. Through customer engagement, market analysis, proposal development, contract negotiations, and cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, operations, and executive leadership, the team helps shape Saildrone's regional strategy and ensures customers realize the full value of Saildrone's autonomous maritime technologies. Our mission is to strengthen maritime security, enhance situational awareness, and support data-driven decision-making through persistent, autonomous ocean intelligence.

THE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute Saildrone's sales and business development strategy across Germany and Selected Eastern European Countries.

• Identify, qualify, shape, and capture opportunities for Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and associated data services.

• Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline that supports ambitious revenue growth objectives.

• Lead customer engagements from opportunity identification through contract award and execution.

• Develop account strategies and long-term customer engagement plans.

• Achieve annual sales targets and contribute to Saildrone's regional growth objectives.

• Support proposal development, contract negotiations, commercial discussions, and bid submissions.

• Act as a subjected matter expert of our next generation platform

• Establish and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders

• Develop a detailed understanding of customer requirements, capability priorities, and future acquisition programs.

• Represent Saildrone at military exercises, trials, demonstrations, conferences, and industry events.

• Support customer operational evaluations and capability demonstrations

• Build relationships with UK and international defence primes, shipbuilders, system integrators, and maritime technology providers.

• Support industrial cooperation, offset, and localization discussions where appropriate

THE QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 8 years of experience in defence, maritime, aerospace, security, or government sales.

• Proven track record of winning and growing complex defence and government business opportunities.

• Strong commercial sales background with responsibility for customer relationships, revenue generation, and business growth.

• Extensive knowledge of the German and European defence acquisition and procurement environment.

• Strong understanding of Germanys governmental and political processes influencing defence spending and capability development.

• Established network across Germanys defence, maritime, and security sectors.

• Experience in engaging with senior military officers, government officials, and industry executives.

• Excellent presentation, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a geographically dispersed team.

• Willingness to travel extensively throughout Germany and Europe,

• Eligibility to obtain and maintain Security Clearance in Germany.

Saildrone offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits tailored to each global region. Please note that specific benefits listed below may vary or be adapted for roles based in Denmark in accordance with local labor standards and Danish market practices.

To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy-policy.

BENEFITS

At Saildrone, we’re building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team’s well-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance.

**The Role

**You will own and lead global communication strategy for our Urology business area, playing a central role in Ambu’s transformation toward more insight-driven, digitally fluent, and customer-centric marketing. Based at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark, you will work closely with other Global MarCom Managers, our Brand & Creation team, Digital Marketing Specialists, Global Product Managers, Medical Affairs, and local sales companies to develop customer-centric, insight-driven, and commercially impactful communication. Your primary team consists of downstream product managers and you will work together on the daily to drive the Urology business forward.

Drive commercial marketing and business impact You will develop and optimize communication throughout the customer journey and your ability to seek out insights, interpret limited data, and translate findings into impactful communication will be essential to our success. From ideation to execution, you’ll ensure alignment, consistency, and commercial impact throughout the customer journey.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Own and lead the development and execution of global communication strategy for Urology, with a strong drive to build data-based customer communication.

• Developing sales enablement materials and content that empower commercial teams and drive engagement with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating closely with the Digital Marketing team to identify performance and adapt communications accordingly.

• Collaborate with the Brand and Creative team to deliver sales & marketing materials that are both on-brand and commercially effective.

**Commercial mindset, proactive and collaborative

**You are a data-driven, commercially minded marketer, motivated by the challenge of building this capability in a less mature environment. You understand customer journeys and develop communication strategies that optimize business impact, even when insights are limited. You are resourceful, curious, and proactive in seeking out insights, and you can turn even small data points into meaningful communication. You enjoy collaborating with others and are eager to help shape our data-driven future. You’re skilled at managing stakeholders and building alignment across global teams.

To succeed, you’ll need: **Skills

**_Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

_

• A Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field

• 10+ years of experience in commercial marketing, acquired in corporate roles, agencies, or both.

• Proven commercial experience within MedTech or Pharma.

• A proven ability to connect marketing to business results through communication & channel strategy, and sales enablement.

• Driven, hands-on, and strong sense of ownership.

• Strong project leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across time zones and functions.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to drive transformation in how we engage HCPs and stakeholders

• Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written)

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is on an ambitious growth journey, expanding globally and pushing the boundaries of innovation in healthcare. Here, your contributions will directly shape our success. You’ll work in an international head office with a collaborative, open culture—where ideas matter, and impact is visible. We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

**When to apply

**If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply. Your application will be treated confidentially.

💰 **Salary, based on experience level:

**🇬🇧 London - up to £92 000 a year/gross

🇩🇰 Copenhagen - up to 74 000 DKK a month/gross

**Intro

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We're looking for a Solution Engineer who's ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins. You'll be the technical partner to our Sales team: you work out what customers need, show them how Monta solves it, and make sure what we sell can be delivered.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Win the technical decision — be the reason charge point operators, energy companies and fleet owners choose Monta to run their charging business.

• Make sure what we sell gets delivered — the commitments made during the sale are realistic and land cleanly with our implementation team.

• Shape the product — turn what you hear from customers into clear input that Product and Engineering can act on.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead technical discovery — understand the customer's business, their current charging setup (platform, hardware, roaming, billing) and what they need to integrate with.

• Run demos built around the customer — tailored to their use cases, not a feature tour.

• Design the solution — define the high-level architecture and integration approach, from OCPP chargers and OCPI roaming to APIs, ERP and energy management.

• Lead proofs of concept and technical evaluations — agree scope and success criteria up front and see them through to sign-off.

• Answer the hard questions — technical, architecture, integration and security questions in meetings, RFPs and security questionnaires.

• Spot risk early — flag gaps and dependencies before a deal is committed, and push back when a promise can't be kept.

• Partner with Sales — on the technical strategy for complex, multi-country deals.

• Hand over cleanly — give the Solution Architect a documented scope so implementation starts on solid ground.

• Close the loop with Product — feed recurring requirements and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.

• Help post-sales when it's busy — for example scoping a migration or running a technical workshop with a live customer.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role — as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer or pre-sales consultant, selling B2B software or platform products.

• You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people — and can go deep with the customer's engineers in the same meeting.

• Your discovery gets to the real problem — you ask the question behind the requirement before proposing a solution.

• You build demos that tell the customer's story — you're comfortable changing course live when the conversation goes somewhere new.

• Hands-on with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, test calls yourself, and explain web-hooks, authentication and data flows.

• Commercial awareness — you understand how deals are won and lost, and you know when to protect scope.

• You write clearly — solution designs, RFP answers and handover notes that others can act on without a follow-up call.

• EV charging, energy or mobility knowledge is a plus (OCPP, OCPI, load management), but not required. We'll teach you the domain.

• You use AI to work faster — for example on RFP drafts, research, demo prep and documentation, and you check the output before it reaches a customer.

• Fluent English, and happy to travel to customer workshops around Europe from time to time.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_****Why Monta

**

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

_Recently graduated or one to two years into your career? Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now.

__Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

**About The Job

**At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and help shape how we work.

**What You Will Do

**As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work within one of our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take responsibility for your own tasks. At the same time, you will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Helping identify and document Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data points with stakeholders and assessing which are critical for Saxo

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and contribute to root cause investigations

• Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation

• Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved

• Collaborating with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

**Who You Are

**You have recently graduated or have around one to two years of professional experience.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• A relevant degree in finance, economics, business analytics, information systems, data science or a similar field

• An interest in data and how it is used in business processes

• Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or projects

• Hands on experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

• Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation

**It would be an advantage if you have

**

• Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job

• Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back

• Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services

• Familiarity with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar tools

Just as important as your experience is how you approach your work.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who

**

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You adapt as priorities develop, bring structure to areas that are still taking shape and contribute to building solutions together with the team.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is your curiosity, initiative and willingness to learn.

**What We Offer

**

• The opportunity to help build a new data function from the ground up

• A steep learning curve across Markets, critical data and data governance, supported by experienced colleagues

• Hands on guidance, regular feedback and an introduction to both your Markets domain and our governance practices

• Real responsibility from the beginning, with the opportunity to take on more as you develop

You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, so your role will develop alongside the team. You can expect new challenges, increasing responsibility and the opportunity to influence how critical data is managed across Markets.

We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.
